full_prompt_en: A square, sharply simplified landscape painting shows an empty road receding between two isolated houses beneath massive storm clouds. The upper half is dominated by layered charcoal and slate-gray cloud shapes. Their scalloped edges descend toward a low strip of warm pale orange light at the horizon, creating an abrupt contrast between dark sky and glowing distance. In the midground at left, a small dark house stands almost in silhouette, with a chimney and simple windows. A row of slender utility poles diminishes from the left side toward the vanishing point. On the right, a larger warm brown house sits slightly forward on a raised dark plane; a steep roof, chimney, porch, and a few small windows are reduced to precise rectangular and triangular shapes. The road begins at the lower center as a pale ochre strip, bends gently, and narrows toward the horizon. Along its left, a mirror-still flooded channel or reflective ground catches the same orange sky, cutting a bright wedge into the dark brown foreground. Blue-gray patches break the reflection at the lower edge. The ground is broad and nearly empty, with the right side a deep black-brown mass and the left a low flat bank. The buildings have crisp silhouettes but little surface detail, and long angular shadows stretch away from the low light. Illumination comes from the distant horizon at the left, gilding one side of the right house and the road while the cloud cover leaves most of the scene in heavy shade. The smooth matte paint has restrained texture and carefully shaped edges, making every large value block count. The overall composition is stark and still, its convergence lines and orange seam of light drawing the eye into a dramatic, unpopulated distance.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、形体高度简化的风景绘画描绘一条空路从两栋孤立房屋之间退向远方，上方压着巨大的暴风云。上半部由层叠炭色和石板灰云形主宰。扇贝状云缘向低低的浅橘色地平光带降落，让暗天空与发亮远方突然对照。左侧中景，一栋小暗屋几乎呈剪影，带烟囱和简单窗孔。一排细电线杆沿左边向消失点逐渐缩小。右侧，一栋较大的暖棕色房屋略靠前，坐在抬高的深色平面上；陡屋顶、烟囱、门廊和几扇小窗都缩减为精确矩形与三角形。道路从下方中央作为浅赭色带起始，轻轻弯曲并向地平线收窄。其左侧，镜面般静止的积水沟或反光地面接住同样的橘色天空，在深棕前景中切出明亮楔形。蓝灰色片在下缘打断倒影。地面宽阔而几乎空无一物，右侧是一大片深黑棕色，左侧是低矮平坦的岸。建筑剪影清楚，却没有多少表面细节；长长的折角阴影背离低位光源伸展。光来自左侧远处地平线，给右侧房屋的一面及道路镀金，云盖让场景大部分留在沉重暗处。平滑哑光的颜料肌理克制、边缘精心塑造，使每块大明暗色域都发挥作用。整体构图严峻而静止，汇聚的线条与橘色光缝把视线拉进戏剧性、无人烟的远方。
style_prompt_en: This stylized landscape treatment organizes the frame into a few broad, smooth matte masses with precise geometric edges. Charcoal, slate, umber, and near-black carry most of the area, while a narrow luminous band of apricot and ochre provides the decisive warm contrast. Long converging strips and sharp angular shadows create depth across otherwise spare planes. Large softly scalloped forms press downward above small rigid shapes, setting an uneasy relation between organic and geometric contours. Surface texture is restrained; value boundaries and silhouette carry the drama. Low distant light catches only selected edges and planes, leaving extensive unlit negative space. The overall effect is quiet, severe, and cinematic.
style_prompt_zh: 这种造型化风景处理把画面组织为少数宽阔、平滑哑光的色块，边缘带精确几何感。炭色、石板灰、棕褐和近黑色占据大部分面积，一条狭窄发亮的杏橘与赭色光带提供决定性暖色反差。长长汇聚的色带与锐利折角阴影在原本稀疏的平面上创造纵深。大型柔和扇贝状形体从上方向下压，下面是小而坚硬的形状，形成有机与几何轮廓的不安关系。表面肌理克制，明度边界和剪影承载戏剧性。低位远光只掠过选定边缘和平面，让大片留白处于无光状态。整体效果安静、严峻而具有电影感。
theme_en: An empty road between two houses beneath storm clouds
theme_zh: 乌云下两栋房屋间的空旷道路
name: George Ault
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
